name: German VAT ID ISO 7064 Mod 11,10 (Heuristic)
description: Validates German Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr.) using the ISO 7064 Mod 11,10 iterative algorithm: product = (2 * ((digit + product) mod 10)) mod 11; check = 11 - product; check = 0 if check == 10. Note: this algorithm is a community heuristic — the BZSt does not publish a normative check-digit algorithm. Structural validation (DE prefix + 9 digits) is applied first; the checksum is advisory.
